environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB in a private subnet. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*and\s+')` with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode at priority 2. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule group evaluation order is respected.

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway for egress, no direct internet ingress
